title: Shape and rank
summary: Shape lists dimension sizes. Rank is the number of dimensions, not a score of model quality.
introduction: Shape lists dimension sizes. Rank is the number of dimensions, not a score of model quality. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Shape lists dimension sizes. Rank is the number of dimensions, not a score of model quality.

blocks.code:
import tensorflow as tf

x = tf.constant([[1, 2], [3, 4]])
print(x.shape, x.ndim)
blocks.title: Shape and rank

blocks.text: The output shows shape (2, 2) and rank 2. This tensor is a two-dimensional table.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not confuse tensor rank with matrix rank from linear algebra.
For more detail later, use this [TensorFlow further reading](https://www.tensorflow.org/guide/basics).
